admission.justification: Prevents replay loading changed live instructions instead of the exact immutable detail bytes of its original request.

applicability: Manifest-declared named-step details used by the original launch, same-request retry or delayed held-seat opening.
conditions: Freeze original detail bytes and revision beside the report and bind rendered references to those immutable per-request paths.
Restoration verifies the saved identities and regular canonical targets before use, refusing changed or nonregular artifacts.
exclusions: No refresh from current live source on replay.
Step details do not hide required inline stage inputs, outputs or authority boundaries.
statement: Launch preparation places immutable step-detail snapshots beside the handover and binds its rendered references to those original bytes.
